weapons.glb.what: The games' weapons (stage 5g; two more in 5n, two in 5o): a dart pistol, a crossbow, a staff, a grenade, a pump shotgun, a launcher, the repeater, the attackers' orb caster, the longshot and the flame lance, each a node of the file at its own origin, fitting the box its look gives it (packages/arms/src/looks.ts), its muzzle at its +Z end.
